newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Hang Seng Index,turnover hit records at close.
newsitem.headline: HK's Hang Seng Index,turnover hit records at close.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks ended stronger on Monday with the blue-chip Hang Seng Index hitting another closing high on record turnover of HK$26.48 billion as liquidity continued to flow into the market, brokers said.
The Hang Seng rose 233.09 points, or 1.58 percent, to finish at 14,990.90, a hair below the all-time intraday high of 14,998.12 reached earlier in the afternoon.
Brokers said the strong rally was liquidity driven, with investors interested in buying property stocks, blue chip laggards and red chips.
"There has been a surge of liquidity. It shows how much money is in the region," said Geoff Galbraith, institutional sales trader at NAVA SC Securities.
There was "fantastic liquidity overhere", Miles Remington, a sales trader at SocGen-Crosby Securities, also said.
The turnover of HK$26.48 billion was much higher than Friday's HK$18.74 billion and well above the last record of HK$20.59 billion hit on May 26.
